discovery.title: Global Settings
discovery.description: Cameras and zones already set up are left as they are.

data_description.auto_discover: Add every Frigate camera as it's found. Switch off to be offered each one instead
data_description.discover_zones: Offer each Frigate zone like a camera, for notifications about that zone alone
data_description.object_names: What to call each of Frigate's objects in every notification, such as car as Vehicle, or a translation. Objects not named here are called as Frigate names them.

health.name: Frigate Health Checks
health.description: Notify when a Frigate server stops responding, and again when it's back. The timing is also used for each camera's own check of its video.

data_description.health_check: Notify when a Frigate server isn't answering the Frigate integration, which asks it for its stats every few seconds anyway.
data_description.health_interval: How often each Frigate server is checked.
data_description.health_retries: How many more times a failed check is tried before Frigate is notified as not responding. 0 notifies the first failure.
data_description.health_backoff: How long before trying a failed check again, doubling for each retry after that.

summary.name: Frigate GenAI Periodic Report
summary.description: A report of activity across multiple cameras for the preceding hours, written by Frigate's GenAI from their reviews, called every few hours or once a day. It goes by e-mail, being too long for a phone's notification or a voice assistant. Each report is written by Frigate's GenAI provider, so is subject to its charges and limits.

data_description.summary_mode: Automatic sends it when Frigate makes GenAI review summaries for any camera.
data_description.summary_interval: Each report covers the hours since the one before, up to the hour it's sent in.
data_description.summary_time: When the first of the day is sent, and the others every so many hours from it.
data_description.summary_concerns_only: Frigate is still asked for the report every time, but it's only sent when GenAI rated one of the reviews in those hours as suspicious or critical, or noted other concerns.
data_description.summary_deliveries: Use the Supernotify 'email' delivery by default, override to choose one or more other deliveries, such as Telegram or the File Notify Entity. If left empty and Supernotify has no e-mail delivery, reports aren't delivered at all.

summary_unavailable.name: Frigate GenAI Periodic Report
summary_unavailable.description: A report of the hours before, written by Frigate's GenAI from their reviews, once a day or more often. It's too long for a phone's notification or a voice assistant, so it needs Supernotify to send it - install it from Marketplace, with an e-mail or alternative delivery, to switch it on here.

data_description.severities: Which of Frigate's reviews to notify. Alerts are what Frigate is set to treat as important, detections are everything else it tracks.
data_description.labels: Only notify when one of these is seen or heard. Leave empty for anything.
data_description.zones: Only notify when one of these zones is entered. Leave empty for anywhere.
data_description.zone_multi: Only notify once every zone chosen has been entered, rather than any of them.
data_description.zone_order: Only notify when the zones chosen are entered in the order listed, such as from the gate to the door.
data_description.status_check: Notify when Frigate has no video from this camera, and again when it's back. Not while the camera is disabled in Frigate. Timed as the Frigate health check in Global Settings.
data_description.power_entity: What powers this camera, such as its PoE port or smart plug, or a schedule of when it's meant to be on. While it's off the camera isn't notified as offline. Leave empty to always check.
data_description.power_grace: How long after it comes on before the camera is checked, for it to start up.

timing.name: Timing
timing.description: When notifications are sent, and how often.

data_description.cooldown: Time after a notification before another is sent for something new. Updates of what's already been notified aren't held back.
data_description.initial_delay: Wait this long before the first notification, for a better snapshot.
data_description.final_update: Send one more notification once Frigate has finished with what it saw.
data_description.final_delay: Wait this long after it's over before that last notification.
data_description.timeout: No more updates after this long, however long it goes on.
data_description.alert_once: Updates replace the first notification silently, rather than sounding again.
data_description.update_sub_label: Send an update when Frigate recognises a face or a number plate.

genai.name: GenAI
genai.description: What Frigate's generative AI adds, its summary of a review and its descriptions of what's in it, each taking the place of the review's notification.

data_description.summaries: Update the notification with Frigate's title and summary once the review is over, when Frigate's GenAI makes one.
data_description.min_threat_level: Leave out summaries below this threat level: 0 normal, 1 suspicious, 2 critical.
data_description.priority_normal: The priority of a summary at threat level 0.
data_description.priority_suspicious: The priority of a summary at threat level 1.
data_description.priority_critical: The priority of a summary at threat level 2.
data_description.descriptions: Update the notification with Frigate's description of each object in the review.
data_description.unreviewed_descriptions: Also notify descriptions of objects Frigate didn't make a review of, such as those outside the zones an alert needs.
data_description.genai_wait: How long after a review ends to keep it for what GenAI adds, and a description for its review.

notify.name: Image and targets
notify.description: The image shown, and who and what is notified. Leave the targets empty for the usual choice.

data_description.image: The image of each notification. Frigate draws the box or crops the snapshot itself. The View snapshot button always shows the whole snapshot.
data_description.targets: Notify entities to send to. Leave empty for every phone with the Home Assistant app.
data_description.target: Who or what to notify, as for any Supernotify notification. Leave empty for Supernotify to choose.
data_description.custom_target: Targets outside of Home Assistant, such as e-mail addresses or phone numbers.
data_description.deliveries: Limit notifications to these Supernotify deliveries. Leave empty for Supernotify to choose.

error.summary_undeliverable: Periodic reports won't be delivered at all: no Deliveries are chosen for the Frigate GenAI Periodic Report, and Supernotify has no e-mail delivery to use instead. Choose a delivery, set Send a report to Off, or save again to keep it as it is.

user.title: Notification rule
user.description: Changes how any notification is sent when its message matches, from a camera, a zone or Frigate's generative AI. Every rule that matches applies: silence wins, then the most urgent priority, and their scenarios are combined.

data_description.match: How the text is looked for in the message, always ignoring case.
data_description.pattern: What to look for, such as HIGH RISK, or a regular expression such as ^(no|low) risk\b.
data_description.priority: Send at this priority. Leave empty to keep the notification's own.
data_description.silence: Don't send the notification at all.
data_description.remove: Take the text matched out of the message, such as a risk level at its start.
data_description.scenarios: Apply these Supernotify scenarios to the notification.

reconfigure.title: Change rule
reconfigure.description: Changes how any notification is sent when its message matches, from a camera, a zone or Frigate's generative AI. Every rule that matches applies: silence wins, then the most urgent priority, and their scenarios are combined.

data_description.match: How the text is looked for in the message, always ignoring case.
data_description.pattern: What to look for, such as HIGH RISK, or a regular expression such as ^(no|low) risk\b.
data_description.priority: Send at this priority. Leave empty to keep the notification's own.
data_description.silence: Don't send the notification at all.
data_description.remove: Take the text matched out of the message, such as a risk level at its start.
data_description.scenarios: Apply these Supernotify scenarios to the notification.

error.invalid_pattern: This isn't a regular expression that can be used.

frigate_not_ready.message: Frigate isn't set up yet, so {name} can't be followed until it is

mqtt_not_ready.message: MQTT isn't available, so Frigate's reviews can't be followed until it is

common.headline: {label} detected at {where}
common.health_down: {server} has failed its health check since {since}, so camera notifications may have stopped.
common.camera_down: Frigate has had no video from {camera} since {since}.
common.camera_up: Frigate has video from {camera} again, after {duration}.
common.supernotify_present: Supernotify is installed, so notifications will have the snapshot, links to the clip, and every delivery it has.
common.supernotify_missing: **Supernotify is not installed.** Only a plain text notification can be sent, to every phone with the Home Assistant app, with no snapshot or links. Install Supernotify from HACS for the full experience.
common.proxy_off: **Frigate's notification proxy is switched off for {server}.** Notifications will have no snapshot, and tapping one won't play the clip. Switch the notification proxy back on in the Frigate integration's options.
common.proxy_expires: Frigate's notification links for {server} stop working {seconds} seconds after each detection, so older notifications lose their snapshot and clip. Set the notification proxy's expiry to 0 in the Frigate integration's options to keep them.
